name: MODS Shortcut
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: A waveform-header MODS button opens SOURCE so you can tap the official MOD MENU.
description: SDK-only emulator preview. MODS sends one bounded native SOURCE press, then displays Tap MOD MENU in the source list. It does not open Mod Menu directly: choose its official SOURCE-list row. Physical navigation and LOAD input cancel the shortcut. One small surface above the waveforms, with separate positions for 2 and 4 DECK layouts. No LOAD, PLAY, audio, library writes or firmware hooks. Disable MODS source shortcut to hide the button.
